caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded pot or jar with a pronounced rim at the top and a handle attached to the upper left side, curving smoothly from the rim to the body. The pot has a reddish-brown color and features variations in shading, giving it a reflective, glazed appearance. The drawing is centered on a plain, light beige background, with no other objects or decoration present. The pot itself occupies most of the central area of the image, and its handle and body are well defined, indicating the source of light with repeated highlights on the surface. The base of the pot is also visible, showing a rounded bottom edge.
title: Bean Pot
